desc:
🐟 Grab baby fish from under a sleeping sea boss and race your boat home before it wakes up!

❗ HOW IT WORKS
Hold to grab a baby: the boss wakes up. When the "!" pops up, run! Reach the grass and it's yours.

🐠 GROW YOUR COLLECTION
Grow babies in your aquarium. Adults earn money every second, even offline 💰 Some grow up Silver, Gold or Diamond 💎 At night, babies grow 30x faster! 🌙

🌊 10 FISHING GROUNDS
Sit on your boat at base to train Speed and unlock new waters, from the Beach to Radiation, each with its own boss: the Whale, the Megalodon 🦈 and more.

✨ 10 RARITIES
From Common to Ascendant. Void, Primordial and Ascendant babies glow with their own aura, and the whole server hears when one spawns.

🏏 Carrying a baby? Other players can bonk you with a bat to make you drop it.

📖 Fill the Index, upgrade your boat and aquarium, and sell extras at the SELL house.
👥 Invite a new friend and you both get bonus cash.
⚡ Join the group for +10K Speed!
